PUZZLE HELP

Puzzle solutions: the first locks

Use the hint first if you want a nudge. Each solution stays hidden until you choose to reveal it.

Guide deskUpdated October 11, 20262 min read
On this pageThe office skullThe mansion disc safeLooking at a number pad?

The office skull

Hint Inspect the skull’s orientation before touching the nails.

Reveal solution
Turn the skull away from you. Press the left, back, right, then top nail to release the Tongue Key.

The mansion disc safe

Hint This sequence assumes the discs are still in their starting positions.

Reveal solution
Rotate the left disc once, then the top disc four times. If you already moved them, the sequence will not apply to that changed state.

Looking at a number pad?

A keypad is a different kind of lock. Open the locker-code guide below to match the location before revealing its combination.
